india_trends.title: Global insurers look to tap India opportunity as 100% FDI lures
india_trends.summary: India's insurance market is becoming a magnet for global insurers, with South Korea's Hanwha Group and South Africa's Discovery among those evaluating opportunities after India allowed 100% foreign ownership. This is set to spur acquisitions and deepen competition across the under-penetrated sector.
